GET /api/wall-of-fame returns expected fields (email, name, role, volunteer_hours, total_donated, badges)
GET /api/wall-of-fame contains admin user (added previously)
POST /api/admin/wall-of-fame/{email} - duplicate user returns 400

POST /api/admin/wall-of-fame/{email} - nonexistent user returns 404

Unauthenticated cannot PUT to wall-of-fame (401)

Frontend: Wall of Fame nav link visible in navbar to all users

Frontend: Wall of Fame toggle button works correctly (add/remove from wall)

Admin-only endpoints properly protected with require_admin dependency
